mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile: the continuous loop made each side of the heart's job clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left-side valves felt repetitive after doing the same thing on the right, even though their purpose was clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that blood inside the chambers cannot supply all the heart's thick muscle; the muscle needs its own vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. Some later steps were the only available combinations, but they followed the stated goals.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter because connecting the routes helped me understand how the heart and body fit together, although the repeated valve fitting was less engaging.
